title: Inspect and extend: Verify API logic and plan safe integration
objective: Use the real implementation in `test/github.test.ts` to demonstrate and safely improve mock response evidence, test script, public api boundary, and token risk.
problem: Mocked responses prove mapping logic without contacting GitHub. Compare tests with API behavior and identify secure credential handling and pagination work needed for a real account client. Your implementation or debugging result must remain consistent with the source architecture.
requirements: Read `test/github.test.ts` and the related project files: test/github.test.ts; package.json; README.md.
Add or improve a focused behavior related to mock response evidence, test script, public api boundary, and token risk.
Add a meaningful unit test or, when platform tooling is unavailable, document a reproducible manual check.
Update documentation to identify local, simulated, external, and missing behavior accurately.
constraints: Do not claim or implement as complete a capability outside this boundary: Do not put a personal access token in a client bundle or commit it into source.
Do not add credentials, personal records, real funds, or unsafe public network exposure.
Keep the change within the existing project architecture and name any new dependencies.
expected_behavior: Mocked responses prove mapping logic without contacting GitHub. Compare tests with API behavior and identify secure credential handling and pagination work needed for a real account client.
acceptance_criteria: The implementation change is traceable to `test/github.test.ts`.
Normal and failure/edge cases are described and tested.
The test outcome and environment are recorded honestly.
README or source comments correctly state remaining limitations.
hints: Read the caller and the closest existing test before editing.
Separate a pure rule test from any UI, device, provider, or network test.
